clue.text: Signal from the Tory now

indicators.note: the answer is made from these letters, taken out of their order and rebuilt

parts.note: taken as written, ten letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A message sent out by the current Conservative party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Signal' looks like a noun but is the adjective meaning remarkable. 'from' tells you to rebuild the letters of THE TORY NOW.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective, signal means outstanding or remarkable, a close synonym.

clue.text: Little drinks spin round

indicators.note: turning a word round means reading its letters in the opposite direction

explanation.surface: A small round of drinks makes the head spin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' turns SPIN back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: Nips are small measures of spirits, tots taken in a single swallow.

clue.text: A number sound as if they bore shoot

indicators.note: the next letters are what a word sounds like when spoken, not how it is spelt

parts.note: to bore a hole is to drill

explanation.surface: Some people sound boring enough to shoot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound as if they' says DRIL is spoken like DRILL, the verb meaning bore.
explanation.definitionFit: A tendril is a thin, curling shoot of a climbing plant.

clue.text: Dreaming of collecting 27 Across's coat?

definitions.meaning: lost in idle daydreams, absent-minded
picking up the fleece of a black ram or ewe, literally gathering its fibre

explanation.surface: A daydream about gathering the fleece of a disgraced sheep.
explanation.walkthrough: 27 Across is BLACK SHEEP; collecting its coat is literally gathering its fleece, and the phrase also means daydreaming.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for absent-minded daydreaming comes from collecting stray tufts of fleece from hedges.

clue.text: Cooks the joints

definitions.meaning: prepares food in an oven
large cuts of meat for the oven

explanation.surface: The chef deals with the meat cuts.
explanation.definitionFit: To roast is to cook in an oven, and roasts are joints of meat so cooked.

clue.text: Teachers redesigned areas

indicators.note: something redesigned has been put together in a new arrangement, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: School staff have reorganised the classroom spaces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redesigned' rearranges the letters of TEACHERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Hectares are metric units of land measurement, each ten thousand square metres.

clue.text: Church recess-a semi-pseudo one

indicators.note: semi means half, so only the first half of the following word is used

explanation.surface: An alcove in church that is only half authentic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'semi' takes half of PSEUDO, its first three letters, PSE, after the A.
explanation.definitionFit: The apse is the vaulted, usually semicircular recess at the east end of a church.

clue.text: Mr. Paul and I are wrongly introduced in the garden

indicators.note: put together wrongly, so the letters must be put in a different order

parts.note: taken as written, the abbreviation point ignored

explanation.surface: A man named Paul and the speaker have been mistakenly presented to someone in the garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrongly' rearranges MRPAUL with I. The definition is loose: the flower has been brought into the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: The primula, the primrose family, is a flower commonly planted and grown in gardens.

clue.text: Four, for example, showing still less feeling

parts.note: even can mean still, as in even better

explanation.surface: An example shows somebody becoming yet more emotionally cold.
explanation.walkthrough: The second word is read as the comparative of numb, not as a quantity.
explanation.definitionFit: Four divides exactly by two, so it is an example of that kind of integer.

clue.text: Musical instrument for the first woman

definitions.meaning: a bandore, an old lute-like stringed instrument
in Greek myth, the first mortal woman, who opened the jar of evils

explanation.surface: A musical instrument named after the first woman.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the mythical first woman and to an old stringed instrument also called a bandore.

clue.text: An epic ode in extremis provides a pain-killer

indicators.note: the words provide the answer from inside themselves, it is tucked within them

explanation.surface: A grand poem at a desperate moment brings relief from pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'provides' finds the answer within 'epiC ODE IN Extremis'.
explanation.definitionFit: Codeine is an opiate drug used to relieve pain.

clue.text: Insect

parts.note: a long-legged fly, the crane fly, named for its spindly legs

explanation.walkthrough: The clue is a bare definition; the crossing letters must do the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the common name of the crane fly, a gangly-legged flying insect.

clue.text: Roadside diversion for dexterous motorists?

parts.note: dexterous suggests the dextral hand, so the motorist changes direction towards that side

explanation.surface: Something to amuse skilful drivers by the road.
explanation.walkthrough: Dexterous comes from Latin dexter, right: so a diversion for them turns that way.
explanation.definitionFit: A turn towards the right side, the dextral one, fits motorists described as dexterous.

clue.text: Cigars even when perfectly blended produce complaints

indicators.note: mixed thoroughly together, so the letters are shuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: Even fine cigars give rise to moans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perfectly blended' mixes CIGARS and EVEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Grievances are grounds for complaint, causes of resentment.

clue.text: Establish connection and tell the tale

definitions.meaning: to link one thing with another
to narrate or recount a story

explanation.surface: Link things up and narrate the story.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate means both to connect two things and to recount a story.

clue.text: Absolutely windless, yet my carvel is wrecked

indicators.note: a wrecked ship is broken up, so the letters are broken and rebuilt

parts.note: taken as written; a carvel is a type of sailing ship

explanation.surface: A sailor laments that, in a dead calm, the ship was still wrecked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is wrecked' rearranges MYCARVEL; a carvel is a small sailing ship.
explanation.definitionFit: With no wind at all, the air is utterly still and the sea quiet.

clue.text: Gouty, drop a lag out

indicators.note: out of order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written; a lag is slang for a convict

explanation.surface: Get rid of a convict who has gout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges DROPALAG.
explanation.definitionFit: Podagra is gout of the foot, so the related adjective means suffering from gout.

clue.text: Seaport storehouse

definitions.meaning: a port where goods are landed for re-export
a warehouse for goods in transit

explanation.surface: A warehouse by the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: An entrepot is a trading port for transhipment and also a warehouse for goods.

clue.text: Sea-cucumber, a Chinese food

definitions.meaning: a marine animal with a soft cucumber-shaped body
dried, it is a delicacy in Chinese cooking

explanation.surface: A sea creature eaten in China.
explanation.definitionFit: Trepang is the dried sea-cucumber, prized as a delicacy in Chinese cuisine.

clue.text: Two join up

definitions.meaning: a pair
to connect or link together

explanation.surface: A pair link up.
explanation.definitionFit: A pair of anything is this word, and as a verb it means to link together.

clue.text: Type of aircraft landing given a tossing

definitions.meaning: a flat landing where the plane drops on its belly
the batter flipped in the frying pan on Shrove Tuesday

explanation.surface: A plane landing that leaves the passengers thrown about.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is cryptic: the thing tossed in a pan.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat belly landing bears this name, and so does the flat batter cake flipped in a pan.

clue.text: The design of Formosa, I conclude

indicators.note: the answer is made of part of the next words, taken from inside them

explanation.surface: A traveller sums up the look of Taiwan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' draws the answer from within 'forMOSA I Conclude'. Formosa is the old name for Taiwan.
explanation.definitionFit: A mosaic is a pattern or picture made of small coloured pieces set together.

clue.text: Musical instrument only effective when depressed

definitions.text: Musical instrument only effective when depressed

parts.words: Musical instrument only effective when depressed
parts.note: a reed instrument whose keys must be pressed down, and which works by suction, so depressed in a mechanical sense

explanation.surface: A gloomy instrument that only plays well when it is sad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depressed' means keys pressed down, not unhappy; this reed organ draws air by suction.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the suction reed organ developed in the United States, played by pressing keys.

clue.text: Have a quick look in both directions

indicators.note: the word reads the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Glance quickly both ways before crossing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in both directions' says the word is the same read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To peep is to glance quickly or furtively.

clue.text: Horse plate

definitions.meaning: a cavalry or war horse
a large flat serving dish

explanation.surface: A horse on a plate.
explanation.definitionFit: A charger is a knight's war horse and also a large flat dish.

clue.text: Mean girl in time

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: An unkind young woman at the time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' looks like unkind but is the arithmetic sense.
explanation.definitionFit: In arithmetic the mean is the average of a set of values.

clue.text: Authors I ghost for produce expiration

indicators.note: the words produce the answer from among their own letters

explanation.surface: A ghostwriter's work for authors ends in a weary breath.
explanation.walkthrough: 'produce' takes the answer from within 'authorS I GHost'. Expiration here means breathing out.
explanation.definitionFit: Expiration is breathing out, and a sigh is a long audible exhalation.

clue.text: One of the farmer's charges is a disgrace

definitions.meaning: an animal in the flock, one with dark fleece
a family member who brings shame

explanation.surface: A farm animal that shames the family.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark-fleeced animal in the flock gives the idiom for the family member who brings shame.
